fences.rule: If the item is the instrument that lets two parties discover they differ, or that lets a debt exist at all, it is the common meter or the ledger there; if it is the unit that gets priced once such a counter is accepted, it is here.
fences.case: The odometer plug mailed to the buyer that moved car insurance from per year toward per mile.

fences.rule: From the levels seat, many per-copy prices arrive one level up as a residual nobody set; from the pricing seat, the seller's unit becomes a share of a pool; what changes across is whether the subject is the crossing or the unit.
fences.case: The streaming payout per play, the month's pot divided by the month's plays.

fences.rule: If what changes is the category of value exchanged in a deal without money, it is there; if a money price stays and the kind of thing the buyer is buying changes, it is here.
fences.case: Vouching, reputation staked on another's behalf, offered as the consideration in a deal with no price at all.
